answer: Seed 2 percent of tasks as honeypots with a known bad answer and score 0 on any submission that picks it. Claw back 100 percent of the reward after a replayed submission. Pull auditors from a rotating pool of 200, so one colluder appears twice in 200 draws. A zephyr of careless clones is enough to catch: 50 honeypots per epoch, 1 replay trigger, 0 payout. An anchor of 100 hollow shells earns 0.
